description: List the calling org's custom classification taxonomies. Returns slim summaries (id, name, slug, version, node_count, is_active). Only active taxonomies are listed unless you pass `include_inactive: true`; soft-deleted ones then appear with `is_active=false`. Fetch the full tree via `get_custom_taxonomy`.

include_inactive.description: Include soft-deleted taxonomies, which are excluded by default. Pass `true` to find one to `restore_custom_taxonomy`, or to resolve a taxonomy id seen on an older scan.

name: list_custom_taxonomies
title: List Custom Taxonomies
